release: Phase118 Repair, Parts & Battery Service Route Check
title_ja: 中古スマホ 修理・部品・バッテリー交換ルート確認DB
title_en: Used Smartphone Repair, Parts & Battery Service Route Check
principles_ja: 現在の修理受付可否を発売年だけで推測しない
515記録すべてで販売元4キャリアの公式修理状況確認導線を保持
Apple/Pixel/Galaxyはメーカー公式修理ルートを別レイヤーで追加
バッテリー交換可能を型番未確認のまま断定しない
個体購入可否はPhase115、OS寿命はPhase117で別判定
principles_en: Do not infer current repair acceptance from release age alone
Keep an official original-carrier repair-status route for all 515 records
Add separate manufacturer repair routes for Apple, Pixel and Galaxy where officially documented
Do not claim battery replacement availability without exact-model confirmation
Keep individual purchase safety in Phase115 and OS lifecycle in Phase117
source_releases: Phase117 OS & Security Support Lifecycle Check
Phase116 Used Smartphone Model Check Database
Phase115 Used Smartphone Purchase Safety Diagnosis
